Dear MAMAMOO,

I just wanted to tell you how happy I am to see you together again.

There are many amazing girl groups in K-pop, but for me, there has always been only one: MAMAMOO. Your voices, your talent, your confidence, your humor, and the way each of you shines while still creating something even more beautiful together have made me a fan for years.

Listening to your new song felt like meeting old friends again. It reminded me why your music has always had a special place in my heart. You don’t just sing—you tell stories, express emotions, and inspire people to be themselves.

Thank you for never losing your unique color and for continuing to share your art with the world. No matter how much time passes, there are fans like me who will always be here, cheering for every comeback, every stage, and every new chapter.

I hope you know that your music reaches people far beyond Korea. Here in Brazil, there is someone smiling because MAMAMOO is back.

I’m rooting for you today and always.

With love,
A Brazilian MooMoo ❤️
